title.zh: Perseus 数字图书馆：《阿尔戈英雄纪》第四卷

notes.zh: 阿波罗尼奥斯·罗迪乌斯史诗的数字文本；塔洛斯与阿尔戈英雄相遇的主要古典来源。
notes.en: Digital text of Apollonius Rhodius's epic; the principal classical source for the Talos encounter with the Argonauts.

notes.zh: 后世神话汇编的英文译本；用于交叉核对塔洛斯的神话谱系，不作为唯一主张依据。
notes.en: English translation of a later mythographic compilation; used to cross-check the Talos tradition, not as the sole support for a claim.

notes.zh: 用于核对塔洛斯的神话身份、克里特岛守卫设定与后世概述。
notes.en: Used to verify Talos's mythic identity, Cretan guardian role and later summaries.

title.zh: 塔洛斯画家红绘涡形克拉特

notes.zh: 约公元前420—400年，阿提卡红绘陶器；画面表现塔洛斯之死。馆藏：意大利鲁沃 Museo Archeologico Nazionale Jatta，藏品号36933/1501。图片摄影 ArchaiOptix，CC BY-SA 4.0；博物馆对商业使用可能另有要求。
notes.en: Attic red-figure pottery, ca. 420–400 BCE, depicting the death of Talos. Collection: Museo Archeologico Nazionale Jatta, Ruvo, inv. 36933/1501. Photograph by ArchaiOptix, CC BY-SA 4.0; the museum may impose additional terms for commercial use.

notes.zh: 本项目原创 SVG，根据《阿尔戈英雄纪》文本重绘，不复制博物馆或出版方图形。
notes.en: Original SVG created by this project from the Argonautica account; it does not copy museum or publisher graphics.

notes.zh: 用于核查《伊利亚特》文本中没有塔洛斯情节；正式提交前仍应由古典学资料再次复核。
notes.en: Used to check that the Iliad text does not contain the Talos episode; a classical-studies review is still required before publication.

title.zh: 塔洛斯画家红绘陶器细节图

notes.zh: 同一件 Jatta 博物馆藏红绘涡形克拉特的细节视图；图片页标注 CC BY-SA 4.0。
notes.en: Detail view of the same red-figure volute krater in the Jatta collection; the file page identifies CC BY-SA 4.0.

title.zh: 鲁沃塔洛斯陶器概览图

notes.zh: 鲁沃 di Puglia 的塔洛斯陶器概览照片；图片页标注 CC BY-SA 4.0。使用前需保留摄影者署名并核对博物馆条款。
notes.en: Overview photograph of a Talos vase in Ruvo di Puglia; the file page identifies CC BY-SA 4.0. Retain photographer attribution and check museum terms.

title.zh: 《The Theatre of the Greeks》图书扫描
title.en: The Theatre of the Greeks book scan

notes.zh: 1860 年公有领域戏剧史图书扫描，可作为纸本资料视觉；不能作为塔洛斯古典文本的唯一证据。
notes.en: Public-domain scan of an 1860 history of Greek drama; suitable as a paper-source visual, but not as sole evidence for the classical Talos text.
